outputs.explanation: Panels Ai-ii show a representative time-lapse of a single mock-treated and a single saccharin-treated cell with no quantification, averaging, or statistical comparison, and no replicate number/type is stated for this panel specifically. Representative images without quantification do not require replicate reporting.

Panel B shows representative phase contrast and fluorescence images of a field of cells at different time points with no quantification or statistics presented, and no replicate number or type is stated for this panel. Representative images without quantification do not require replicate reporting.

replicate_statements: The images shown are representative examples from a minimum of three biological replicates.
outputs.explanation: The caption explicitly states the images are representative of a minimum of three biological replicates, providing both the number (n ≥ 3) and type (biological replicates) of replication. Since the panel shows only representative images without summary statistics, this reporting is sufficient.
